test_IterationManager_full_iteration: test the IterationManager class by iterating over all epoch, edge path, and edge chunk combinations
test_IterationManager_partial_iteration: test the IterationManager class with a specific iteration_idx to get a single iteration tuple
test_IterationManager_tampering: test the IterationManager class by mutating iteration_idx, edge_paths, and num_edge_chunks mid-iteration
test_IterationManager_properties: test the IterationManager class epoch_idx, edge_path_idx, edge_path, and edge_chunk_idx properties
test_IterationManager_checkpoint_metadat: test the IterationManager get_checkpoint_metadata method to return iteration state as a dictionary
